description: Etat des parcs-relais du réseau STAR en temps réel is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Jeu de donnée de l'état d es parcs-relais du réseau STAR en temps réel Etat des parcs-relais du réseau STAR en temps réel, comprenant notamment l'état d'ouverture,l'état de remplissage, la capacité totale du parc-relais ainsi que la capacité et la disponibilité pour chaque type de place. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are parc-relais, voiture, parking, places, disponibilité, temps réel. The portal shows 8 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
